start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:read-what-i-pulled-from-an-account with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and source example-source, account sample."
no_lists_because: It names no list: what was pulled is kept as account-snapshot parts in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:read-what-i-pulled-from-an-account" with store, the source and, when you want them, the account, thread and limit. Read only: nothing is written.

3. The first run looks at what the store keeps, makes the account-snapshot parts' objects once if they are missing, and proves the reading on the example parts: every answer must be the one the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run reads the parts of that source and account and answers the summary, or one conversation's last messages.

worked_examples.title: The conversations I pulled from one account
worked_examples.ask: Read the conversations I pulled from my example account

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The store keeps the account-snapshot parts for example-source and default, with one state part and one thread part, C0000SAMPLE, one message.
